purpose: Extract only time-bearing or resolution-bearing market events from unofficial source messages.
extract_when: A future or ongoing event/date/window is stated or implied.

A policy, financing, FX flow, M&A, earnings, contract, regulation, sanction, supply/demand, buyback, issuance, lockup, sale, intervention or other market-moving process has a trackable resolution condition.
The claim can be checked later against official evidence or market reaction.
do_not_extract_when: Pure opinion without a checkable event or time/resolution dimension.
Generic market direction prediction with no causal event.
Duplicate repost with no new evidence.
guardrails: Do not invent dates, amounts, entities, official status or consensus.
Preserve source id/url/channel and the original claim meaning.
A source claiming that something is official does not make it official; official status comes from official-source verification.
Price reaction never upgrades truth status by itself.
decision_card.current_view must come from OUR_MI only; expert or rumor claims may appear only as labeled evidence/context.
